name: FPSO Kikeh (Kikeh field, offshore Sabah)
description: 120,000 bopd process capacity; water depth about 1,300 m; first deepwater FPSO in Malaysia and Asia

sources.note: Offshore Engineer, 26 Jan 2022: built 2007, first and largest deepwater FPSO in Malaysia and Asia, 120,000 bopd, PTTEP charter extension. MISC Berhad took full lease-and-operate ownership from SBM Offshore in 2025 (sbmoffshore.com newsroom, 6 Sep 2024).
